concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 (multiple‑comparisons correction) is not addressed anywhere in the implementation plan. The plan should state that no family‑wise correction is needed because only two models are compared, or explicitly reference SC-002.

Success Criterion SC-003 (causal inference disclaimer) is absent from the plan. The plan should include a statement that the work is purely predictive/associational and does not make causal claims, satisfying SC-003.
